newsitem.title: CHINA: HK's HACTL July cargo throughput up 15.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK's HACTL July cargo throughput up 15.4 pct.

text.p: Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Ltd (HACTL) said on Thursday its throughput in July jumped 15.4 percent to 144,369 tonnes compared with the same month in 1996.
HACTL attributed the growth to the application of automation and information technology in cargo operations, it said in a statement.
Exports climbed 19 percent to 69,091 tonnes compared with the same period in 1996, while imports surged almost 11 percent to 58,145 tonnes.
Transhipment rose 17.4 percent to 17,134 tonnes, it said.

HACTL is 25 percent held by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd, 20 percent by Swire Pacific Ltd, 12.5 percent by Wharf (Holdings) Ltd, 12.5 percent by Hutchison Whampoa Ltd and 10 percent each by CITIC Pacific Ltd, China National Aviation Corp and Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd.
